findings.body: A light review requests GPT-6 Sol at medium effort, but this return path accepts a completed report without checking the model and effort actually used. `_attempt` records a model fallback at `src/forge/review.py:358-360`; the sign-off path checks its selected model and effort at lines 311-314. If Autoreview falls back, `forge close` can commit a P0-only review performed by another model. Require the light review's reported selection to match before accepting it.

findings.body: Every case supplies green checks. The test therefore still passes if `forge close` stops waiting for tests or CI on the light-review path. The red-check cases in `tests/test_close.py:273-317` start fixes without the prototype allowance, so they exercise only the strict path. Add a light-review case with a failed test check and one with a failed or missing required CI check, asserting that close does not report ready.

findings.body: This assertion checks only the arguments sent to Autoreview. The stub emits no selected model or effort, so the test passes even when the completed review used a fallback model. `tests/test_proto_signoff.py:148-167` shows the existing way to supply and check fallback and lower-effort output. Add that case through `forge close` so the required GPT-6 Sol medium review is verified at the command boundary.
